source.title: Disenchanting/Shard Help — Aspalar firsthand rare disenchant averages
source.author: Aspalar

inputName: Midnight rare (blue) gear, pooled item IDs unspecified
skill: Max Midnight Enchanting and max profession skill from tools (exact effective skill not reported)
specialization: Max Knowledge Points for rare/blue disenchanting (Shard Supplier); exact allocation not stated
stats: Blood Elf racial; max skill from profession tools; crafting secondary stats not reported
notes: Original firsthand commenter says approximately 5,000 disenchant operations, not an exact completed-cast denominator; casts deliberately null. The same cohort supports both rank-specific rows, not two independent samples. Reported aggregate 1.45 shards per disenchant conflicts with sum of separately reported 0.42 and 0.97 (1.39); retain original values without resolving the discrepancy. No raw logs, zero counts, positive stack histogram, item IDs/levels, armor-vs-weapon split, actual build, or output item IDs. Published March 10, 2026; do not presume later hotfix applicability. Research-only skill/spec-specific averages; do not assert measured probability.
